behaviour: Names the latest released instalment with its date, citing pmkisan.gov.in or PIB: up to 30 Oct 2026 that is the 23rd instalment, released by the Prime Minister on 20 June 2026 from Tarakeswar, Hooghly (West Bengal); the 24th is scheduled for 30 Oct 2026 (Gujarat). If the question is asked after the 24th has been released and the bot cites an official page showing that release, naming the 24th (30 Oct 2026) as the latest is correct.
fail_if: It names a wrong instalment number or date, calls the 20 June 2026 release the '20th' instalment, says the 24th has been released without an official source, or quotes blog/YouTube dates.
summary: 23rd (20 Jun 2026, Tarakeswar) still latest on 28 Oct 2026, but the 24th is officially scheduled for 30 Oct 2026 (PM Events listing; pmkisan.gov.in banner image); answer rebuilt to accept the 24th once released.
